extract: On the Isle of Man they serve a traditional form of the modern donut, made from severed owl rectums dipped in Daz washing powder, meanwhile there is some Scrotum bunting third door on the right!

title: Alanis Morissette's Tin Opener
description: A tragic tale of lost throats and overdue library fines.
extract: No charcoal today, but I do have a used tin opener belonging to Alanis Morissette, she used to sleep on it before she got an iPhone, she wants her throat back before the library fines her!

title: Tracey Chapman's Lea & Perrins Hustle
description: Salman Rushdie's Ford Focus and a violent reaction from Tina Turner.
extract: Tracey Chapman sold the bragging rights to Lea and Perrins sauce, pretending it was a Ford Focus that once belonged to Salman Rushdie! This caused Tina Turner to projectile vomit in the Amex arena when trying to size up some sandblasted flip flops.

title: Jemima Puddleduck's Revenge
description: A half-eaten hearing aid, a spiteful forge, and a suet-stuffed Cortina.
extract: What's this about you swallowing half a hearing aid? Jemima Puddleduck is so angry about it! She brought a forge out of spite, and hid a substantial amount of suet in her mom's Cortina.

title: The Portaloo Penny Farthing Prophecy
description: An unexpected journey through dairy-based wordplay.
extract: Claire Warwicker was surprised to find out that Primula cheese is a French anagram of Andre Agassi so she conjured a penny farthing out of a portaloo and rode it into a tin of tuna, for some 1995 panini stickers and a pair of milky bar loafers.

title: Bad Max and the Manifesto Tsunami
description: A cat-led milk parade meets highbrow absurdity.
extract: Bad Max dumps a two-timing faculties manifesto on a tidal wave of dry synecdoche. Elsewhere on a tied-up sundries minister in Basildon on twat, a cat becomes the first gas giant to lead a milk parade without killing any handicapped marzipan.

title: Branston Pickle and the Pope's Bargain Hunt
description: A divine intervention at Basildon Matalan.
extract: Branston Pickle once a day on your dog's nipples will force the Pope to stay in Basildon Matalan... unless it's 3pm, and you're at Tuesday's car boot sale with your nan, trying to flog her malfunctioning ferret barometer.

title: Husky Strimmers and Narwhal Shenanigans
description: Pets at Home just became a crime scene.
extract: Sandra Bingedick breeds huskies with a petrol strimmer whereas her sister Trisha Pengelly fingered a narwhal round the back of Pets at Home, filthy bitch!

title: Jean-Claude Van Arrested
description: A Greggs uniform, a football stadium, and a Yazz classic.
extract: Jean Claude van Damme was arrested for singing 'The Only Way Is Up' at Selhurst Park in a Greggs uniform. His mother ate horse dung while enlisting for the Welsh infantry.

title: Lord Mountbatten's Gallbladder and the Tattooed Ducks
description: A new lunar tradition with anatomical consequences.
extract: To welcome in the new moon, I've decided to get a tattoo of a chalkboard on my shin together with Lord Mountbatten's Gallbladder and a couple of pinstripe ducks throwing up maggots!

title: Fiesta or Pickled Eggs? The Mexico Dilemma
description: Prince Philip, a raisin, and Cameron Diaz walk into a bar...
extract: A Ford Fiesta is also known in Mexico as a jar of pickled eggs, thought Steve, as Cameron Diaz tripped over a 49-foot-long raisin forcing Prince Philip to sell his Sega Mega Drive to a twice-fingered midget!

title: Pavel Nedved's Thumb War of Destiny
description: Household appliance shopping meets Crimean combat.
extract: I went shopping for a new hoover, and ended up having a thumb war with Pavel Nedved, whereas my wiflet went shopping for Pavel Nedved and ended up with no thumbs in the middle of the Crimean War!

title: Mattress of Cocktail Umbrellas
description: The delicate line between wolf fish and sentient prunes.
extract: When I'm bored, I like to stuff my mattress full of cocktail umbrellas and pretend I'm a baby wolf fish, or occasionally pretend I'm a sentient prune and dust off my jellied eel collection.

title: Magpie Zippers and Toadstool Dreams
description: A five-hour jumble sale ends in zipper failure.
extract: Kiss me, Barnacle Bob, my zipper's busted on the old rusted magpie after a five-hour sucker punch jumble sale. I'm off now to where toadstools smoke withered dreams outside the genital warts convenience store.

title: The Dripping Washbasin of Fate
description: An existential crisis disguised as a plumbing issue.
extract: The broken petrol station toilet washbasin tap of fate drips persistently on the ennui of absent-minded indulgence until it finally opens the novelty biscuit tin of destiny; inside is both more than you deserve and less than you hoped for.

title: Katie Hopkins and the Amphibious Bigots
description: An artist's desperate attempt at songwriting.
extract: Katie Hopkins is on hand with a fountain pen and some disabled sugar. She has been heavily guarded by her own lazily diluted wrists, but some bystanders say she has been trying to harvest new Radiohead songs from a swarm of amphibious bigots!

title: Ryan Air's Testicle Poo Ban
description: Danny DeVito clones, Stephen Hawking, and airborne newts.
extract: Ryan Air just stopped letting passengers catapult testicle poo at passing Danny DeVito clones during flights through Stephen Hawking's corpse. Quickfit has reported dangerous levels of racist newts in the back end of Paul Gascoigne.

title: The Sandwich Paste Law
description: New legislation forces strange dietary habits.
extract: The law has recently changed: Everyone must eat sandwich paste every second of every day. You must not say 'puffin' more than three times in a working day. You can only melt down replicas of Olivia Newton John if you're wearing winkle pickers!

title: Winkle Pickers: A Frozen Affair
description: New fashion rules for those recreating Olivia Newton John.
extract: Newsflash: Winkle pickers are to be frozen before, during, and after sex, unless you're melting down replicas of Olivia Newton John, whereby they must be suspended three feet above your shed.

title: Carbon Paw Prints and Clam Shaft Sauce
description: The Pope's latest environmental initiative.
extract: All farmers must sew a dalmatian to their wives' shoulders to offset their carbon paw print. The Pope must create his own brand of clam shaft sauce, only to be sold in cold 'sounding' towns. Airfix mammoths are banned!

title: Kippy's Landfill Lunch Date
description: An unusual lonely hearts ad.
extract: Fat duckhorse seeks yellow Wednesday for friendly seaside landfill lunch. Ring Kippy on double seven five one five slippery sick barefoot eggnog face plant!

title: Cranefly Vs. The Vauxhall Astra
description: The car industry reels from an Edwardian flourish.
extract: I've been reliably informed by a tall penguin that craneflies can't find reverse in a Vauxhall Astra. This is due to a strong bout of Edwardian flourish and piss-stained permafrost.

title: Toad Piercers Wanted
description: An unconventional dating ad for the bold and adventurous.
extract: Dyspraxic toad piercer would like to meet jumble sale organisers for casual meddling, shrimp welding, and donkey-themed barometer sex.
